metadata.source: ACS 5-yr 2019-2023 block-group estimates allocated to 2020 Census blocks (TIGERweb geometry; 2020 PL 94-171 block counts) refined with Boston building footprints (public/data/buildings.geojson)
metadata.method: Count fields = block-group value x block share. Share = 2020 block pop (persons) or housing units (households). For blocks fully inside the building-data bbox, share = 50% decennial share + 50% residential floor-area share (pooled so block-group totals are preserved). Residential = land_use R1-R4,RC,A,CM,CD; floor area = footprint x round(height/3.5). Medians and poverty are copied from the block group / tract, not allocated. Estimates, not measurements: inherit ACS margins of error.
